vya_text: gU0 - atha mUrdhatailakarNapUraNavidhiH | tatrAdau lepaH lipto lepaH lepanaM tAni trINi Alepasya nAmAni Bavanti | nAmakathanaM saMj~jArthaM paryAyakathanArthaM ca | sa lepastridhA triprakAraH mataH kathitaH | ekaH doShaGnaH SothAdinASakaH | doShaSabdenApi rogA ucyante | dvitIyo viShahA BallAtAdiviShanASakaH| tRutIyo varNyaH muKavya~ggAdivarNakaraH | evaMBUto muKalepaH muKyo lepaH tridhA | muKaSabdena muKya ucyate | tathAca viSvaH ‘muKaM ca vadane muKye Adau dvArAByupAyayoH’ iti | punaH lepastripramANaH trINi pramANAni yasya saH | tadvidhAnamAha - caturBAgaH a~ggulasya catvAro BAgA yasya saH pUrNA~ggula ityarthaH | sa tu doShaGnaH | triBAgaH trINi a~ggulAni yasya saH triBAgaH sa tu viShahA | ardhA~ggulottamaH ardham a~ggulapramANam unnata uccaH, sa tu varNyaH varNakaraH | sa ArdraH aSuShkaH CaviM kAntiM dUShayati || 1 || 2 ||

dI0 - tridhA mata ityanena eko doShaGnaH dvitIyo viShahA kathitaH aparastu varNya iti tridhA saMj~jo~asminmate~anyatrApi prasiddha eva | sa eva varNyo muKalepaH kathitaH | na tu catvAro BedAH vakShyamANatvAt tripramANa iti teShAM doShaGnAdInAM trayANAM traya eva parimANA yathA~anukrameNa boddhavyAH | sa kathaMBUta: | caturBAgaviBAgArdhA~ggulonnata iti | etena kimuktaM | doShaGno lepaH a~ggulasya caturBAgapramANenotsedhaH kuryAdityaBiprAyaH | evaM viShahAlepastu triBAgotsedhaH kAryaH | triBAgatA~ggulasyeti saMbandhaH | varNyo lepaScArdhA~ggulonnata eva kuryAt | athArdraSuShkayoH PalamAha | Ardro vyAdhihara ityAdi | sa pUrvokto lepo yAvadArdro Bavati tAvadvyAdhiharo j~jeyaH | yadA SuShko Bavati tadA na vidUShayati | CaviH CAyA sA ca varNApraBopalakShitA | ‘ tathAca varNapraBASritA yA ca CAyA sA parikIrtite’ti | nanu CAyApraBayostu ko BedaH | ucyate ‘varNamAtrapraticCAyA praBA varNaprakASinI | AsannAt lakShyate CAyA praBA dUrAcca lakShyate’ iti | na kevalaM varNapraBAcCAyAnAM lakShaNaBedaH | saMKyABedopyastIti | tadyathA caturdhA varNaH gauraH kRuShNaH SyAmaH gauraSyAma iti | praBA ca saptavidhA raktA pItA sitA SyAmA haritA pANDurA siteti | CAyApi pa~jcavidhA snigdhA vimalA rUkShA malinA saMkShiptA iti || 1 || 2 ||

atha daSA~ggalepo visarpaSothavraNAdau –
(daSA~ggalepaH)

vya_text: gU0 - SirIShaM, mAMsI jaTAmAMsI, niSAyugmaM haridrAdvayaM, vAlakam udIcyaM, cUrNAtpa~jcamAMSaM GRutaM daSA~gga iti daSa a~ggAni auShadhAni yasya saH GRutaM tu prakShepakadravyaM tadBinnam || 4-6 ||

dI0 – atha daSA~ggalepasaMj~jakaM lepamapyAha - atra SirIShaH SirIShavRukShatvak | eke pa~jcA~ggaSirIShamatra yojayanti prayogAntaradarSanAt | tathAhi - ‘SirIShapa~jcAMgatuShodakena kalkIkRutaM caiva GRutena yuktam | nihanti visPoTakamugrarUpaM sadAhapAkasrutirAgayuktam’ iti | yatra tva~gmUlapuShpANi PalAnya~ggAni pa~jca veti | niSAyugmamiti haridrAdvayaM | pa~jcamAMSaGRutapluta iti | sakaladravyANAM samaBAgamilitAnAM cUrNaM kRutvA tadanu jalena saMpiShya paScAtpa~jcamAMSena GRutena saMplAvya lepaH kAryaH | pa~jcamAMSamatra dravyaparimANAt || 4-6 ||

pada:
varNyo lepo yathA -
raktacandanama~jjiShThAlodhrakuShThapriya~ggavaH | 
vaTA~gkurA masUrASca vya~ggaGnA muKakAntidAH || 9 || 
mAtulu~ggajaTA sarpiH SilA goSakRuto rasaH | 
muKakAntikaro lepaH piTikAvya~ggakAlajit ||10|| 
lodhradhAnyavacAlepastAruNyapiTikApahaH | 
tadvadgorocanAyuktaM maricaM muKalepanam || 11 ||
siddhArthakavacAlodhrasaindhavaiSca pralepanam | 
vya~ggeShu cArjunatvagvA ma~jjiShThA vA samAkShikA || 12|| 
lepaH sanavatIto vA SvetASvaKurajA maShI | 
arkakShIraharidrAByAM mardayitvA vilepanAt || 13 || 
muKakArShNyaM SamaM yAti cirakAlodBavaM dhruvam | 
vaTasya pANDupatrANi mAlatI raktacandanam || 14 || 
kuShThaM kAlIyakaM lodhrameBirlepaM prayojayet | 
tAruNyapiTikAvya~gganIlikAdivinASanam || 15 ||

vya_text: gU0 - raktacandaneti sugamaM | vya~ggalepaH vya~ggaSCAyA | atha tAruNyapiDakAdau - mAtulu~ggo bIjapUramUlaM, sarpirGRutaM, SilA manaHSilA goSakRut gopurIShaM tadrasaH kAlaM kAlimA | atha tAruNyapiDakAdau - dhAnyaM prasiddham | siddhArthakaM sarShapAH ete trayo yogAH piDakAdau | atha vya~gge-arjunatvak arjunavRukShatvak mAkShikaM madhu Sveto yo~aSvaH GoTakastat KurajanyA maShI Basma muKaSyAmatAyAM punaH - mAlatI jAtI kAlIyakaM dAruharidrA || 9-15 ||

dI0 - atha viShahA lepamaBidhAya samprati varNyalepamAha - raktacandanAdIni vyastAni samastAni saMgRuhya jalenApiShya lepaH kArya iti saMbandhaH | atra priya~ggurlatAviSeShaH tasyAH PalAni | vaTA~gkurA iti vaTasyABinavAH patramukulAH | masUro~annaviSeShaH | mAtulu~ggo bIjapUrakaH tasya jaTA mUlaM | SilA manaHSilA | goSakRuto rasa iti | goSakRut gopurIShaM tasya rasa ityarthaH | dhAnyaM dhAnaSabdavAcyam | tadvadatitAruNyapiDakApahopyayaM lepo boddhavyaH | gorocanA prasiddhA siddhArthaka iti | atrApi tAruNyapiDakApaha iti saMbandhaH | tena siddhArthAdidravyacatuShkairlepo yauvanapiDakApaho BavatIti matAntarAt | arjuno vRukShaviSeShaH sa ca kauhASabdavAcyaH tasya tvak CallI | ma~jjiShThA prasiddhA | samAkShikA dhAtumAkShikasaMyuktA | sacArjunatvak ma~jjiShThA vA | tena vikalpatvAt tvaca eko yogaH ma~jjiShThAyA dvitIyo yogaH | aSvaKurajanitasya kajjalasya tRutIya iti | eke SvetA aparAjiteti vyAKyAnayanti | eke arkakShIramiti BinnapadaM haridrAByAmiti dvivacanatvena haridrA dAruharidrA yojyeti vyAKyAnayanti | etatsarvatra na pracarati tenArkakShIraharidrAByAmeva yogaH sAdhuH| vaTasya vaTavRukShasya pANDupatrANIti | pariNatatvAtteShu pANDuratvaM tAdRuSAnItyarthaH | mAlatI jAtI tasyAH patrANi kAlIyakam aguruBedaM pItasAramiti loke | kecidvaTaSca pANDupatrANItI paThanti tatra vaTa ityanena vaTavRukShasya patrANi pANDuH paTolastasyApi patrANItyarthaH | etanna sarvamatam | aprasiddhatvAt || 9-15 ||

dI0 - tiktapaTolaH kaTukapaTolaH tasya patrANAM rasa ityarthaH | tadvilepanAditi | tattasya rasasya lepanAt | triBireva dinairityanenAsya viSiShTatvaM darSitam | nAtra tridinaireva niyatapramANaM yato bahudinasevyo~ayaM prayogaH | bRuhatIrasa iti pakkabRuhatIPalajanitarasasyaiko yogaH | gu~jjAyA mUlaM PalaM vA dvitIyo yogaH | atrA~api madhupracAraH | BallAtakaPalaM tRutIyo yogaH | eke BallAtakarasopi vetyasya sthAne~avikShIreNa saMyutamiti paThanti | tena BeDIdugdhena gu~jjAPalaM saMGRuShya lepaH kArya iti saMgataH | saMpradAye tu indraluptasthAnaM prasthayitvA tadaBAve saMGRuShya paScAllepaH kArya iti sAdhuH | uktamanyatrApi - ‘bRuhatIPalarasasaMpiShTaM gu~jjAPalamUlamindraluptasya | kanakaviGRuShTasya tato dAtavyaM prasthitasya sade’ti | gokShuraH prasiddhaH | tilapuShpANi viKyAtAni | tulye sAmye gokShure satilapuShpe ityarthaH | madhusarpiShI ca | tulye~atra grAhye | maShIkajjalaviSeShaM hastidantaM dagdhvA kajjalaM kAryam | rasA~jjanaM dvividham ekaM kRuShNapAShANasadRuSaM dravyaviSeSham | aparaM dArvIkvAthasamudBavam | tadaBAve dAruharidraiva grAhyA | ayaM lepaH keSavardhanArthamityAhuH | yaShTI madhuyaShTI indIvaraM nIlotpalaM tadaBAve padmabIjamapi grAhyam | padmabIjaM gaTASabdavAcyam| mRudvIkA gostanI drAkShA | eke mRudvIsthAne mUrveti pAThAntaraM paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | tailAni prasiddhAni | AjyaM GRutaM kShIraM gopayaH | tilAjyakShIrasthAne tilAjakShIralepanairitipAThaH | tatrA~ajakShIramityarthaH tilAjyakShIramArkavairityapi pAThAntaraM saMgatam | tathAhyuktaM ‘madhukendIvaramUrvAtilAjyagokShIraBRu~ggalepena | acirAdBavanti keSA GanadRuDhamUlAyatA mRudava’ iti | catuShpadAH go~aSvAvyajeBeNaKaroShTrAdayaH | teShAM tvak carma romanaKaSRu~ggAsthIni prasiddhAni | tena tvagAdInAM dagdhvA Basma kAryaM tailaM tilasaMBavam || 20-25 ||

pada:

gu~jjAmUlaM PalaM vApi BallAtakaraso~api vA |
gokShurastilapuShpANi tulye ca madhusarpiShI || 22 || 
SiraHpralepanaM tena keSasaMvardhanaM param |
hastidantamaShIM kRutvA CAgIdugdhaM rasA~jjanam ||29|| 
romANyanena jAyante lepAtpANitaleShvapi |

vya_text: gU0 - indraluptaM keSanASalakShaNam | tiktapaTolaM bRuhatI kaNTakArI BallAtakarasaH patrarasaH | indralupte - madhusarpirdvayaM tulyaM tulye auShadhatulye keSaH saMvardhate hastidantaM tanmaShI Basma rasA~jjanaM Karparama~jjanaM vA| pANitaleShu hastatale~api romANi jAyante | indralupte-yaShTI madhuyaShTI indIvaraM kamalaM mRudvI drAkShA tailaM tilajam AjyaM goGRutaM kShIraM gavyam AjaM vA | indralupte catuHpAdAnAM tvak-roma-naKa-SRu~gga-asthi eShAM BasmAni tailena lepaH romasa~jjananaH indralupte || 20-25 ||

dI0 - ayorajo lohacUrNaM tadaBAve lohamalamityeke | ikShurase ikShurasapUrite BANDe mAsamekaM yAvatsthitaM Bavati | ayaM kRuShNIkaraNatvAtpalitaM jayedityarthaH | kecidatra dhAtrIPalAdInAmapi karShANi grAhyANi | lohacUrNakarShaparimANadarSanAt | tena dhAtrIPalAnAM karShadvayam | harItakI karShadvayamitA | karShaikaM biBItakaPalam | AmrAsthimajjAH pa~jcakarShA iti naitatsarvasaMmatam| asmatsaMpradAye tu dhAtrIPaladvayameva grAhyam | evaM harItakIPaladvayam | ekaM viBItakaPalam AmraPalAnAM pa~jcasaMKyAkaM majjA evaM pracarati | pralepo~atra jalena | triPalA harItakyAdikaM | nIlikA nIlinI viKyAtA tasyAH patrANi lohaM lohacUrNaM | BRu~ggo mArkavaH samamiti sakalaM samamAtram | ajAmUtreNa saMpiShTamityasya sthAne avimUtreNa saMpiShTam iti pAThaH | aviH BeDI | dADimatvagityanena dADimaPalasya tvak valkalaM grAhyaM | bisamiti mRuNAlakamalanAlamityarthaH | pratyekaM pa~jcapalikamityanena triPalAyAH pa~jcadaSapalAni grAhyANi | BRu~ggarAjarasasya ShaTprasthAH | teShAM nava tilAni rasasyetyarthaH | etatsiddhaM yadA Bavati tadA Ajadugdhena saha lepanaM deyamiti BAvaH | SeShaM subodham || 26-34 ||

pada:

sthitamikShurase mAsaM lepanAtpalitaM jayet |
dhAtrIPalatrayaM pathye dve tathaikaM biBItakam || 28 || 
pa~jcAmramajjA lohasya karShaikaM ca pradIyate |
piShTvA lohamaye BANDe sthApayeduShitaM niSi ||29|| 
lepo~ayaM hanti nacirAdakAlapalitaM mahat |
triPalA nIlikApatraM lohaM BRu~ggarajaH samam ||30|| 
avimUtreNa saMpiShTaM lepAtkRuShNIkaraM smRutam |
triPalA lohacUrNaM ca dADimatvagbisaM tathA ||31|| 
pratyekaM pa~jcapalikaM cUrNaM kuryAdvicakShaNaH |
BRu~ggarAjarasasyApi prasthaShaTkaM pradApayet || 32 || 
kShisvA lohamaye pAtre BUmimadhye nidhApayet |
mAsamekaM tataH kuryAcCAgIdugdhena lepanam || 33 ||

svapetprAtastataH kuryAtsnAnaM tena ca jAyate || 34 || 
palitasya vinASaSca triBirlepairna saMSayaH |

vya_text: gU0 - keSakalpe lepaH pAtAlayantreNa tailena | kAlA atiSyAmAH | keSakalpe - ayorajo lohacUrNaM BRu~ggarAjaH BRu~ggarAjacUrNaM kRuShNamRuttikA taDAgakardamaH etanmAsam ikShurase sthitaM lepAtpalitaM keSaSauklyaM jayet | keSakalpe-dhAtrI AmalakI PalatrayaM pathye harItakyau dve ekaM viBItakaM pa~jca AmrANAM majjA lohasya karShaM piShTvA lohamaye BANDe sthApayet | uShitaM niSi sthApitamacirAt SIGramevAkAlapalitaM svalpadinajanyaM keSaSauklyaM hanti | keSakalpe-nIlikApatraM nIlapatraM BRu~ggarAjo mArkavaH aviH BeDaH tanmUtreNa | kRuShNIkaraM SyAmakaraM | keSakalpe-bisaM kamalamUlaM spaShTamanyat || 26-34 ||

dI0 - atha romaSAtanamAha - Sa~gKacUrNamatra BarjitaM deyamiti saMpradAyaH | haritAlasyaiko BAgaH manaHSilA cArdhaBAgeti | tena ekaBAgApekShayArdhaBAgA | eke svarjikA caikaBAgikA iti vA pAThaH | SeShaM sugamaM | tAlakaM haritAlaM SANadvayaM grAhyaM | kadalIkandatoyena veti pAThaH sAdhuH | ravipatrarasena arkapatrasvarasena vA | ayamapi Sa~gKacUrNaM pracarati | anyato darSanAt | tathAhi -‘palASaBasmAkShitalasya cUrNaM raMBAmbumiSrairupalipya BUyaH | kandarpagehe mRugalocanAnAM romANi rohanti kadApi naiva’ | asyApi saptanirlepAdityanena pUrvavatkAryaH || 35-39 ||

Svitre lepAH |
suvarNapuShpI kAsIsaM viDa~ggAni manaHSilA | 
rocanA saindhavaM caiva lepanAcCvitranASanam || 40 || 
vAyasyeDagajAkuShThakRuShNABirguTikA kRutA | 
bastamUtreNa saMpiShTA pralepAcCvitranASinI || 41 || 
tAlakaM SANamAtraM syAccatuHSANA ca bAkucI | 
gomUtrapiShTaM taccUrNaM lepanAcCvitranASanam || 42 ||

etadbastidhAraNasaMketatrayaM doShakAlAdiviShayaM | nAsAkarNamuKasrutirityanena tanmalasravaNaM | kutaH SiraHsthitaromakUpagatailapraBAvAt | doShasaMvalanAdvA | athavA vedanayA yAvadupaSamaH SItastAvacCirobastirdhArya ityarthaH | etaddvitayasya kadAcidaniyatatvAt tRutIyaM niyatakAlamAha - A rujaH SAnterdhArayedvAte pitte yAmaM, yAmArdhaM kaPe iti | mAtrAlakShaNaM ca yathA vAgBaTe - ‘yAvatparyeti hastAgraM dakShiNaM jAnumaNDalam | nimeShonmeShakAlena samaM mAtrA~asya sA smRutA’ iti | atha kasmin kAle Sirobasti: kAryastamAha -vinA BojanaM vinetyanena pUrvAhNe~asya pracAraH samIcInaH | atreti caturdhA mUrdhataile | tena kevalabastireva BojanAdau kAryaH | nABya~ggAditritayamityaBiprAyaH | atha yAvaddinaparyantaM bastiyogo vidheyaH tAvaddinasaMKyAM darSayitumAha - pa~jcAhaM saptAhaM yAvaddoShAdibalApekShayAvagantavyaM | pa~jcasaptadinagrahaNamatra sAmAnyam | vyavahArastvekadinamAraBya yAvadrogasaMkShayastAvaddinaparyantaM kArya ityasmadIyasaMpradAyasyABiprAyaH | atha kena prakAreNa bastyapanayanaM tamAha | Siraso mastakAt basticarmapuTakaM vimocya yatnena dUrIkRutya samantataH parito gRuhNIyAt tailamiti SeShaH | arthAtpUrvaM tadBRutatailaSeSheNApi niyatabastiM vimocayediti BAvaH | paScAtkAryamAha - UrdhvakAyamityAdi | UrdhvakAyaM mastakaM koShNanIrairitIShaduShNaiH | nanUShNajalaiH SirapariSheko na pathyatamaH | tathAca ‘uShNAmbunAdha:kAyasya pariSheko balAvahaH | tenaiva tUttamA~ggasya balahRutkeSacakShuShAM’miti | tatkathamatra vihitam ? ucyate, atra koShNairityanena kiMciduShNajalena sakRudeva snAnaM, na tu bahaloShNajalenetyarthaH | idAnIM bastividhAnena kRute sati tadguNaviSeShamAha - vya_text: gU0 – karNasrAve - AmrajambUnAM patrANi madhukasya vaTasya ca pallavAni eBiH sAdhitaM kRutaM tailaM pUtikarNarogaSAntikRut | pUtikarNe pUraNamiti sugamam || 150 ||

dI0 - mUtrayutena haritAlenaiko yogaH | kevalasArShapatailena dvitIyaH | asmatsaMpradAye tu gomUtreNa haritAlaM saMpiShya tena kaTutailaM vipAcya tattailaM grAhyamiti pracarati | ‘athavA sArShapaM tailaM karNakaTiharaM param’ ityasya sthAne ‘dhUpanaM karNadaurgandhye gugguluH SreShTha ucyata’ iti kecitpaThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca || 151 ||

pada:

pUraNaM haritAlena gavAM mUtrayutena ca
athavA sArShapaM tailaM karNakITaharaM param || 151 ||

vya_text:
